definitions.explanation: The percentage charged for borrowing money or paid for depositing money.

examples.japanese: {低|てい}{金利|きんり}{時代|じだい}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The era of low interest rates continues.

examples.japanese: ローンの{金利|きんり}を{比較|ひかく}する。

notes:
A fundamental concept in banking and economics.

Common expressions:
- {金利|きんり}を{上|あ}げる/{下|さ}げる (raise/lower interest rates)
- {低|てい}{金利|きんり} (low interest rate)
- {高|こう}{金利|きんり} (high interest rate)
- {変動|へんどう}{金利|きんり} (variable interest rate)
- {固定|こてい}{金利|きんり} (fixed interest rate)
